description: Today's (or any date's) Chinese almanac page, tong shu (通勝 / 黄历), computed from real astronomical positions and shown as a Daily Alignment card: Chinese lunar date (农历), year and day pillars (ganzhi 干支), day officer (建除) and whether the day is favorable, current and next solar term (节气), the day's zodiac animal (生肖) and its relationships, five-phase colour, exact moon phase and the next new and full moon. Covers questions like 'what is today in the Chinese calendar', 'today's almanac', 'lunar date today', 'what day is it in the Chinese calendar', '今天农历', '今天黄历'. Uses the location the client shares when no city is given. Dates 1901 to 2099.

city.description: Optional. City name, e.g. 'Los Angeles' or 'Paris, France'. Omit to use the user's location.

include_planetary_hours.description: Include the 24 planetary hours. Default false.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Omit to use the user's location.

name: get_almanac_day
title: Chinese almanac for a day
